features.heading: Everything your practice needs
features.sub: Built for clinicians and independent practitioners who want less admin work and more time with patients.
features.scheduling_desc: Full calendar view with daily, weekly, and monthly modes. Manage in-person and online appointments, block time, and send automated reminders.
features.patients_desc: Complete patient profiles with personal data, contact info, appointment history, and custom tags. Search and filter across your entire patient base.
features.records_desc: Timeline-based medical notes with rich text. Document each session, track patient evolution, and attach exams and files — all securely stored.
features.prescriptions_desc: Issue digital prescriptions in seconds. Maintain a personal medication library, customize templates, and send directly to patients.
features.payments_desc: Collect payments directly through the app. Send payment links to patients, manage installments, and track paid and pending sessions.
features.analytics_desc: Understand your practice at a glance. Revenue reports, appointment stats, patient growth — clear insights to help you run a better clinic.

cta.heading: Ready to simplify your practice?
cta.sub: The app is live and ready — download it now and have your practice running in minutes. The website is on the way.

accountDelete.title: Delete your account
accountDelete.intro: Send us your request below. We'll process it within 30 days and confirm by email.
accountDelete.professionals: Healthcare professionals: you can also close or delete your account yourself in Settings. If your patients have medical records, the law requires keeping them for 20 years: we close your account, keep the records inaccessible for that period, then delete them. Without medical records, your account is deleted.
accountDelete.patients: Patients: we delete your account. The records your clinic keeps about you stay with the clinic; contact the clinic about them.
accountDelete.doneSub: We'll process it within 30 days and confirm by email.

accountClose.closeIntro: Your patients have medical records, so your account can't simply be deleted. Closing it:
accountClose.closeLogin: Deletes your login, contact details, photo, payment and practice details immediately.
accountClose.closeRecords: Keeps your medical records and patient list, inaccessible to anyone, for the legal retention period (20 years), then deletes them permanently. Your name and professional registration stay on the records as their author.
accountClose.closePatients: Archives your {patients, plural, one {# patient} other {# patients}} and cancels {appointments, plural, =0 {no upcoming appointments} one {# upcoming appointment} other {# upcoming appointments}}. Patients who use the app are notified.
accountClose.closeTeam: Removes access for {secretaries, plural, one {# team member} other {# team members}}.
accountClose.closeEmail: You can use the same email to open a new, empty account.
accountClose.deleteIntroProfessional: This permanently deletes your account and your practice data. It can't be undone.
accountClose.deleteIntroSecretary: This permanently deletes your team account. The clinic's data isn't affected.
